assumptions: M1-z is applied as the protocol writes it, on the 20 m grid of each area: z_vh = (VH after dB - dry mean dB) / dry spread dB.
Permanent water is ESA WorldCover 2021 class 80; it is never flagged and is left out of the compared cells of every measure.
The terrain answer comes first: HAND above the limit or a slope of 5 degrees or more is answered not flooded even where the radar has no value.
A cell without a HAND or slope value that terrain does not answer gets no answer; the protocol does not name this case, it is a data gap.
The no-answer share and the binding IoU are counted on the compared cells only; a cell without an answer counts as not flagged in the binding IoU.
The parameters are those the tuning record selected by the protocol's rule; nothing is chosen here.
Lower flood = the selected z limit minus 0.5; upper flood = plus 0.5; the other parameters as selected.
confidence_basis: Frozen on three other events; the Nan references have not been opened.
what_this_is: The frozen M1-z of the Nan case: parameters, flood levels and the SHA-256 of the code that applies them, fixed before any reference of the case is read.

selection.why: 2 eligible candidate(s) within 0.01 of the best mean IoU 0.513293; the tie rule took the first
selection.constraint_rule: amendment 1: in every set, a no-answer share at most 0.10 above the lowest share any candidate reaches on that set

comparators_fixed.r37_frozen_detector: Decision log R37 frozen detector (simple_threshold_cleaned): VH after, a 3 by 3 mean at 20 m (the 5 by 5 at 10 m), at or below -18.46 dB; flags on slopes of 5 degrees or more dropped, then groups of fewer than 2 cells (800 m2), then growth into touching cells within 1.5 dB.
comparators_fixed.r37_simple_threshold: Decision log R37 simple threshold: VH after, a 3 by 3 mean at 20 m, at or below -18.46 dB; no cleaning.
comparators_fixed.un_spider_dry_mean_before: UN-SPIDER recommended practice with the dry-season mean of VH as its image before; groups of fewer than 2 cells at 20 m (the 8 cells at 10 m).
comparators_fixed.m1_literal_dry_mean_before: M1-literal (frozen configuration) with the dry-season means of VV and VH as the image before, per 10,240 m lattice tile at 20 m.
comparators_fixed.m1_v2_dry_mean_before: M1-v2 (frozen configuration, checked by geoid_m1_review.require_frozen_m1_v2) with the dry-season means as the image before, per lattice tile at 20 m.

limits: C-band radar does not see water under trees, between buildings or under rice canopy, nor water that drained before the pass.
The references are other maps (optical water read by a fixed rule, an agency layer, another satellite's map), not ground checks.
Every figure is agreement with a reference layer, not accuracy. Planning guidance only; not an official warning.
